data.name: Ithaman
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name ITHYMOS (ITHYMOS), meaning 'dedicated to God'. In the New Testament, Ithamar (ITH'-a-mar) is the name of a priestly descendant of Aaron.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are deeply devoted to God.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Ithaman tend to be innovative, generous, self-confident, and able to achieve great things.
